title: polytoca heteroclita
intro: Polytoca heteroclita, commonly known as  "Golden Spleenwort," is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is a medicinal herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asia, due to its health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Polytoca heteroclita include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the plant is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, and is also valued for its potential to enhance cognitive function and memory.
